source_pr.title: L05 demo: selected documents reveal an import-boundary violation
source_pr.description:
Adds a standalone offline fixture and two repository documents for the Project Context rehearsal. The api module deliberately imports a db module, violating the selected documented boundary. The fixture is outside the application build and is never imported by product code.

The live review should cite the actual changed import plus docs/course-context/api-boundary.md, distinguish a policy violation from SQL injection, and preserve agent/Skill context inheritance in its trace. Validation: the standalone module executes and returns the expected constant status; no production behavior changes. This PR remains open as an educational review example.

A deliberate educational fixture may still violate its stated rule; distinguish that policy violation from an exploitable security defect. Return the required structured review; zero findings is valid when no rule is violated. Purpose or scope never excuses a real defect.
